column1: # Purpose: single source of truth for every PostgreSQL LOGIN a deployed process uses: which
#   business authority (NOLOGIN role created by migrations/) it joins, the exact GRANT shape the
#   repo tests prove, and which service/env var consumes its DSN (deploy-design §9.3).
# Format: TAB-separated, 6 columns, '#' lines are comments:
#   login  authority  grant  set  consumer(service:ENV_VAR | -)  proof(test file:line with that grant)
#   grant: in_role       = GRANT <authority> TO <login>      (== CREATE ROLE ... IN ROLE; INHERIT, SET TRUE)
#          inherit_noset = GRANT <authority> TO <login> WITH INHERIT TRUE, SET FALSE
#   set:   core  = provisioned now; media = documentation only (media-worker is MOCK-only and not
#          deployed, internal/integrations/livekit/worker_env.go:174) until T08 makes it deployable.
# Runs as/in: read by deploy/postgres/provision-logins.sh (inside the provision-logins container,
#   mounted at /provision/logins.tsv), deploy/scripts/secrets-init.sh (pw_/dsn_ file names and
# Reads env / secrets: none (this file holds names only; passwords are /run/secrets/pw_<login>).
# Used by: see above; consumers' DSN files are /run/secrets/dsn_<login> -> <ENV_VAR>_FILE in compose.yml.
# Status: DESIGN; verified by smoke S13 (17 logins authenticate, membership matrix matches, ruling 19
#   runtime River privileges). The Stripe/claims/registrar logins were added for R1 (stripe-psp-v1 §12,
#   meta-claims-intake-v1 §4.1/§7); lc_stripe_registrar and lc_meta_registrar are OPERATOR-ONLY:
#   only the `ops` one-shot jobs stripe-admin / meta-admin use them, never a long-running service.
# Change rules: a new login needs (1) a row here, (2) pw_/dsn_ rows in deploy/secrets.manifest.tsv,
#   (3) the secret + *_FILE wiring in deploy/compose.yml, (4) a test proving its grant shape.
#   internal/platform/platform.go validatePoolAuthority rejects a login in more than one authority.
